label: Fideist reply to the definition bridge, unattributed reconstruction: conciliar definitions are…
paraphrase: Fideist reply to the definition bridge, unattributed reconstruction: conciliar definitions are second-order theological formulations about the practice, not part of its grammar; the grammar of 'God' is shown in first-order religious life (worship, prayer, confession of sin), and doctrinal formulae may themselves carry a philosophical distortion of that life, which philosophy is to clarify, not to accept as given.
